description: Search 800K+ video games — filter by genre, platform, release date, Metacritic score, with ratings, screenshots, and store links (RAWG)

dates.description: Filter by release date range YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. "2024-01-01,2024-12-31")

genres.description: Filter by genre IDs — comma-separated (e.g. "4" for action, "5" for RPG, "4,5" for both)

metacritic.description: Filter by Metacritic score range "min,max" (e.g. "80,100" for highly rated)

ordering.description: Sort field: name, released, added, created, updated, rating, metacritic. Prefix with "-" for descending (e.g. "-rating")

page_size.description: Number of results per page (default 20, max 40)

platforms.description: Filter by platform IDs — comma-separated (e.g. "4" for PC, "187" for PS5, "186" for Xbox Series)

search.description: Search query for games (e.g. "The Witcher", "Red Dead Redemption")

name: rawg.games.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Search Video Games
